The bundled Skill lets the current Session create and maintain workflows throug"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"h tools, while the diagram and Markdown remain synchronized and portable."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"It is intentionally an editor—not a workflow runtime. DeepSeek Flow helps you design, inspect, and i"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"mprove a workflow; execution remains in the current Session."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What it gives you"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Markdown as the source of truth** — one master `WORKFLOW.md`, plus one `STEP.md` workspace for e"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ach step.
- **A real visual editor** — create, move, connect, reconnect, label, and delete nodes and"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" arrows.
- **Two-way synchronization** — edits made on the canvas and in the Markdown editor are wri"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"tten back to the workflow files.
- **Source-aware topology transactions** — human canvas edits recei"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ve a full current-Session review; topology produced by direct Session file edits can use an invisibl"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"e deterministic finalize path instead of being sent back to the same Session.
- **Executable gate se"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"mantics** — the exported contract includes formulas, operands, predicates, and deterministic Boolean"},{"id":"p10s8","text":" results without running Agent steps.
- **Per-session isolation** — each Harness session keeps its o"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"wn workflows, with optional shared templates; the canvas toolbar can delete the current workflow or "},{"id":"p10s10","text":"shared template behind a guarded confirm (managed workspaces move to a trash area and can be recover"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"ed).
- **Comfortable large-flow navigation** — collapsible and resizable side panels, pan and zoom, "},{"id":"p10s12","text":"fit-to-view, animated node focus, and independent scrolling regions; node drags commit once on point"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"er release and background sync polls lightweight revisions, so large graphs stay smooth.
- **Native "},{"id":"p10s14","text":"theme support** — the interface follows Harness light and dark themes and the active WebUI language."},{"id":"p10s15","text":"
- **Manual AI assistance** — run logic validation, optimize one document with review, or optimize t"},{"id":"p10s16","text":"he complete workflow.
- **Background AI jobs** — switching documents, views, or sessions does not in"},{"id":"p10s17","text":"terrupt accepted jobs; document proposals are restored when you return.
- **Persistent results and d"},{"id":"p10s18","text":"rafts** — logic-validation findings, AI proposals, and unapplied canvas drafts are persisted to disk"},{"id":"p10s19","text":": view switches, session switches, and `dsh web` restarts lose nothing; they are cleared only by an "},{"id":"p10s20","text":"explicit discard or a successful commit. Markdown edits inside the 650 ms autosave window are flushe"},{"id":"p10s21","text":"d immediately when you leave the view.

In a Session, ask the Agent to **build a workflow** or **import a workflow**. The bundled `deepse"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ek-flow` Skill guides it to `flow_create` or `flow_put`.
2. Open **DeepSeek Flow**. The plugin scaff"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"olds a master document, step documents, and their visual layout.
3. Ask the Session Agent to change "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"the workflow files, or select a document and edit its Markdown directly.
4. Direct Session/file-driv"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"en topology updates are finalized without another main-Session review. The Agent should call `flow_f"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"inalize_canvas`; if it forgets, Studio falls back to detecting that no canvas edit event occurred an"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"d presses the same invisible finalize action automatically.
5. When **you** add, remove, rename, or "},{"id":"p18s8","text":"connect boxes on the canvas, click **Apply changes**. DeepSeek Flow validates the graph, asks the cu"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"rrent Session Agent to review it, validates again, and atomically saves a new revision.
6. Return to"},{"id":"p18s10","text":" the Session when you want the Agent to execute the workflow."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"A typical workflow directory looks like this:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Agent tools"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| `flow_create` | Create a documented linear or branched workflow and save it in the current Session"},{"id":"p23s2","text":". |
| `flow_list` / `flow_read` | Discover workflows and read the master document, step documents, r"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"evision, graph, and logic contract. Both also return the session's `activeFlowId`, plus a one-shot `"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"activeFlowNotice` after the user switches the active workflow in Studio — the agent should then run "},{"id":"p23s5","text":"the switched workflow and ignore earlier instructions about other workflows; without a notice, keep "},{"id":"p23s6","text":"the conversation seamless. |
| `flow_put` | Import or atomically update a complete flow definition. "},{"id":"p23s7","text":"A successful call is already persisted. |
| `flow_evaluate` | Evaluate Boolean gates from upstream v"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"alues without running Agent steps. |
| `flow_finalize_canvas` | After direct file edits, queue Studi"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"o's invisible deterministic finalize action and skip a redundant main-Session review. |
| `flow_dele"},{"id":"p23s10","text":"te` | Delete a Session flow or shared template; managed workspaces are moved to trash. |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The Skill is registered reactively when the Harness `skills` service becomes available. Its `SKILL.m"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"d` contains real Markdown after frontmatter, so filesystem and runtime providers never return an emp"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ty instruction body."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Active workflow & cross-session switching"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The Studio toolbar's workflow dropdown lists **every historical workflow**, grouped by origin: curre"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"nt session first, other sessions next, shared templates last. Switching to another session's workflo"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"w imports an independent copy of its document workspace into the current session — external custom `"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"docRoot`s are referenced, never copied. Shared templates are also copied into the current session's "},{"id":"p26s5","text":"own managed workspace on switch, so edits never pollute the shared original."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
